entries.title: One classical price is the current output
entries.next_action: Freeze a task contract for each original source family, specifying one classical discounted price and all financial inputs.
alternatives: Separately labelled portfolio or state-output experiments
acceptance: Contract fixes payoff, model, dates, asset covariance, notional, tolerance and 99% per-price confidence.
Every proposed algorithm returns the same scalar; variants never replace its benchmark.
entries.stop_rule: No tuning until the task file is saved; unknown archived parameters are recovered from code/results rather than guessed.
entries.on_pass: Close the task portion of G0 and start the frozen baseline inventory.
entries.on_fail: Mark unrecoverable fields as missing evidence and use another fully specified original case.
steps: Resolve B4/B8 knock-out separately from C4/H8 residual and Heston/compound cases.
Copy original parameters and hash references.
Specify what a delivered numerical price must satisfy.

entries.title: Dollar accuracy cannot be silently weakened
entries.next_action: Express all candidate error bounds in discounted dollars at the existing notional.
alternatives: Relative/norm-error conversion with proved scale bounds
acceptance: Retain the original epsilon grid, including $0.001 only in its declared cases.
Amplitude, payoff range and discount factors are explicitly converted; no unannounced relaxation.
entries.stop_rule: One dimensional/unit audit per source family; unsupported conversions make the candidate ineligible.
entries.on_fail: Fix normalization or close that candidate interface; keep stricter tolerances as sensitivities only.
steps: Identify price scale and discount.
Translate each approximation and estimator error.
Check units in every budget formula.

entries.title: The complete price needs the complete confidence allowance
entries.next_action: Create the common deterministic-error and probabilistic-failure ledger with an explicit allocation policy.
alternatives: Cost-optimized shares after valid bounds exist
acceptance: The sum of certified dollar errors is at most epsilon; total allocated failure is at most 0.01.
Every term is a bound, an assumption or unknown, with no zero-filled missing certificate.
Hardware, moment pilots, reference checks and sequential stopping have distinct failure entries.
entries.stop_rule: One complete ledger skeleton; unresolved terms keep G2/G3/G5 open rather than delaying unchanged integer experiments.
entries.on_pass: Use the ledger to qualify changed precision/loaders and all full-runtime claims.
entries.on_fail: Retain exact finite-source results and investigate the largest unbounded term first.
steps: Enumerate law, discretization, arithmetic, synthesis and estimation errors. For compound/residual families include the same-policy baseline, surrogate and nonnegative exercise-policy regret terms; these are not obligations for a plain knock-out price.
Separate deterministic bias from failure probability.
Version allocations before outcome-sensitive experiments.

entries.title: Tenfold advantage is a chosen threshold
entries.next_action: Regenerate onefold and tenfold ratios with separate source-only and complete-runtime fields.
acceptance: Verify tenfold budget miss equals 10*T_Q/T_C using identical timing conventions.
A miss of the 10x target is not labelled a quantum slowdown unless T_Q exceeds T_C.
entries.stop_rule: One unit/identity check over every emitted comparison row; unsupported complete times remain blank.
entries.on_pass: Use ratios consistently in C14 and G5.
entries.on_fail: Correct interpretation and regenerate local tables without altering old evidence.
steps: Read actual before/after source costs.
Separate modelled and timed inputs.
Export onefold, tenfold and source-only fields.

entries.title: The statistical allowance of 0.45 epsilon is adjustable
entries.next_action: Optimize a small preregistered error-allocation grid after each component has a valid dollar bound.
acceptance: Each row satisfies epsilon and failure constraints with integer estimator rounds.
Any selected cheaper source preserves the financial certificate and the same confidence.
entries.stop_rule: Three feasible allocations for one case; if a source bound is missing, retain the original split and defer optimization.
entries.on_pass: Adopt the minimum complete certified cost, then reevaluate C13/G5.
entries.on_fail: Keep the cheaper valid baseline rather than optimizing on unproved error estimates.
steps: Enumerate costs as functions of tolerance.
Round actual stage counts.
Price source changes, pilots and repeats together.

entries.title: Correct digital arithmetic is not a continuous financial-law certificate
entries.next_action: Prove one-coordinate Gaussian-to-digital-law bias before composing a full-path price certificate.
alternatives: Explicit finite-grid/distribution discrepancy plus tail bounds
acceptance: Tail cutoff, finite-grid law, function approximation and payoff effects are bounded separately.
Compose over all required normals; gate truth tables or random draws are not substituted for financial bias.
entries.stop_rule: One coordinate plus one monitoring date first; a failed composition leaves the loader branch conditional and prompts a different bound.
entries.on_pass: Close G2 for the chosen source: add C07 for barrier payoffs and E11 only if a variance-sensitive estimator needs the tight digital-moment bridge.
entries.on_fail: Preserve current precision/law; compare a refined grid or a tighter coupling before adopting a new loader.
steps: Write the exact finite sampler distribution.
Bound its discrepancy from the declared continuous law.
Propagate through a bounded truncated path and include remaining tails.

entries.title: A few draws without barrier flips do not certify rare flips
entries.next_action: Bound the probability of the monitored basket lying within an arithmetic-error band around the barrier.
alternatives: Certified interval integration of a boundary band
acceptance: Prove path discrepancy eta and surviving-payoff discrepancy zeta on the stated truncated domain.
Bound discount*(zeta + M*P(any barrier band)) and add independent law/tail errors.
Targeted samples validate implementation only; they do not certify rare-event probability.
entries.stop_rule: Try two analytic/interval bounds on one date; if neither composes within its allowance, forbid lower precision for this contract.
entries.on_pass: Compose across dates and permit only precision choices meeting G2.
entries.on_fail: Keep current precision and record the failed precision-reduction branch.
steps: Find a valid conditional distribution or interval enclosure.
Bound one-date boundary mass.
Apply a justified union/composition bound over dates.

entries.title: Fitted convergence exponents are not lower bounds
entries.next_action: Freeze PCA basis, development/validation split and exponent-fit procedure before evaluating alternative classical representations.
alternatives: Seeded alternative bases and eligible conditioning methods
acceptance: Report fit-window, scramble-unit uncertainty and rate intervals.
Holdout outcomes are not used to select a basis or tune a slope; measured rates are not lower bounds.
entries.stop_rule: Use the existing Stage C design where compatible; a changed design is a separate locally versioned experiment.
entries.on_pass: Supply uncertainty-aware comparator inputs to C09/G4.
entries.on_fail: Report instability and widen the evidence range without preserving a desired advantage verdict.
steps: Respect the existing PCA degeneracy finding.
Freeze configuration and seeds.
Evaluate development selection once on reserved cases.

entries.title: Modelled classical time is not a timed successful price
entries.next_action: Complete the locally specified Stage C time-to-accuracy run using its actual target sample count and reference-price checks.
alternatives: One eligible challenger selected on development data
acceptance: Record actual setup/warm timing, delivered interval and reference agreement.
Use the declared confidence procedure; modelled per-point extrapolation is labelled separately.
Preserve existing Stage C work and its specification rather than replacing it.
entries.stop_rule: Run one B4 target first, then the declared B8 target; a resource-limited incomplete run is reported incomplete, never timed-success evidence.
entries.on_pass: Close G4 only for validated cases; use the fastest eligible successful price.
entries.on_fail: Fix reference/coverage/kernel issues in a new run, or mark that case unresolved and continue independent arithmetic.
steps: Inspect ongoing Stage C implementation and receipts.
Recover its preregistered configuration.
Run prescribed sample counts and report timing and uncertainty together.

entries.title: The strongest tested classical method is not automatically the strongest applicable one
entries.next_action: Make an applicability matrix of classical challengers before implementing the next one.
alternatives: MLMC/PDE/tensor methods if the contract assumptions hold
acceptance: Every exclusion states the failed assumption; one eligible challenger receives the same task, error and setup accounting.
Report strongest tested, not universally fastest, unless an exhaustive claim is independently justified.
entries.stop_rule: Screen three families and implement the best eligible development candidate; stop an inapplicable method before performance claims.
entries.on_pass: Update G4 and tighten quantum budgets if the challenger wins.
entries.on_fail: Keep the strongest demonstrated baseline and list bounded search exclusions.
steps: Check model and payoff compatibility.
Compare pilot work and mathematical error guarantees.
Validate the selected method on held-out cases.

entries.title: A clean source is not an entire mean-estimation algorithm
entries.next_action: Compile one complete estimator iterate for the same source family and reconcile every wrapper cost.
alternatives: Measured bounded estimator where outer coherence is unnecessary
acceptance: Include normalization, source/inverse, reflection, rotations, synthesis, repeats, stopping and readout.
Never multiply residual-estimator query counts by knock-out source depths.
Source, estimator and price contracts share an explicit compatible identifier.
entries.stop_rule: One small complete iterate/repetition schedule first; incompatible interfaces stop that combination.
entries.on_pass: Use G2/G3/G4/H18 to produce a complete G5 scenario.
entries.on_fail: Keep the component result at L4 and repair the interface before claiming price runtime.
steps: Match source and estimator contracts.
Test the small iterate including control-off identity.
Export exact calls and wrapper/synthesis costs.

entries.title: Six constructions share three contracts and one toolchain
entries.next_action: Maintain an evidence-family table and independently structured replacements for shared toolchain components.
alternatives: Direct loading or a separate arithmetic backend
acceptance: Label six constructions over three contracts as shared evidence.
Each independent replacement implements the same numerical target and has its own correctness/cost receipt.
entries.stop_rule: Reuse existing exact replacement evidence; add a new independent backend only when its finite screen is promising.
entries.on_pass: Credit the verified component gain once and update the shared-evidence map.
entries.on_fail: Report the bounded implementation result without inferring an algorithm-independent obstruction.
steps: Map each construction to shared modules.
Attach existing independent arithmetic checks.
Identify remaining correlated assumptions.

entries.title: Optimizations interact and cannot be multiplied without a compatible schedule
entries.next_action: Adopt improvements only through one combined emitted source and a resource-matched schedule.
alternatives: Exact compact packing plus current arithmetic
acceptance: Preserve unaffected target/leaf hashes and replay combined binding/cleanup.
Compare at equal resource caps or show the full Pareto tradeoff.
No product of overlapping module savings; removal of a module removes its separate optimization credit.
entries.stop_rule: Combine two compatible changes at a time; reject a combination on correctness, cap or certified-cost failure.
entries.on_pass: Set the new accepted local baseline, then re-rank the remaining hotspots.
entries.on_fail: Retain the last accepted baseline and record the interaction causing rejection.
steps: Start from constant_multiplier_v1.
Add the next exact change alone.
Compare actual full-source costs and valid capped replays.

entries.title: A classical cubic exponent is not necessary for a crossover
entries.next_action: Evaluate the actual complete inequality without imposing a classical cubic-exponent prerequisite.
acceptance: Use measured/certified inputs and compatible full quantum costs.
Report break-even and tenfold conditions without universal exponent or impossibility claims.
entries.stop_rule: One operating-point grid; unresolved estimator/hardware inputs are assumptions and cannot close G5.
entries.on_pass: State a scoped crossover or scoped miss with its reproducible assumptions.
entries.on_fail: Preserve the negative/component result and identify the remaining dominant cost rather than forcing a new workload.
steps: Calculate T_C and complete T_Q at each declared epsilon.
Separate observed/modelled/extrapolated rows.
Propagate uncertainty and report both ratios.

entries.title: References and stale numerical summaries need individual checking
entries.next_action: Bind every reused numerical/literature claim to an exact version, locator and cost boundary.
acceptance: Store title, version/date, claim, locator, assumptions and transfer conditions.
Every hardware anchor, external compiled-circuit timing and source-screen conclusion has a checked or unverified status.
Do not refresh scientific claims from snippets or treat a selected screen as exhaustive.
entries.stop_rule: Audit the references actually used by the next experiment first; missing primary evidence excludes that number from accepted costs.
entries.on_pass: Use verified claims with their conditions and preserve historical manuscript evidence unchanged.
entries.on_fail: Mark the claim unverified, substitute a supported bound if available, and continue without fabricating a value.
steps: Verify repository numerical claims locally against artifacts.
Read primary texts for externally reused claims when needed.
Record source dates, experimental/theoretical status and unresolved transfer assumptions.
